## Description and Rationale

We are a team of two Computer Science students and an engineering student, with a shared interest in aviation.

We joined the challenge to apply our technical skills to a real-world aviation problem, explore how machine learning and optimisation can improve efficiency, and challenge ourselves to develop an innovative solution as a team.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: United Kingdom
* Number of team members: 3
